Denver secondary cluster: CB Patrick Surtain II + S Talanoa Hufanga both officially OUT (Denver Gazette 10/14)

notes: Away injury adjustment: -1.0 pts -- Zach Charbonnet (RB, out, -1.0).

analysis: DraftKings: Seahawks -2.5, total 40.5, moneyline Seahawks -142 / Broncos +120 (no-vig Seahawks ~58.5%, Broncos ~41.5%). BookMaker.eu (sharp) has Seahawks -140 and the same 2.5 spread, total 41 -- books agree closely on this one. Model: Broncos win 47.4% and cover 55.8% at the market number, projected total 43.5 (injury-adjusted) with 57.9% over. The model still reads this as more competitive than the market price, and the total gap over DK stayed wide even after moving Charbonnet from questionable to a confirmed OUT, which (correctly) trims Seattle own offense a touch rather than widening the gap further.

Denver is playing without both projected CB1 (Patrick Surtain II, ankle, officially OUT per Denver Gazette 10/14) and starting safety (Talanoa Hufanga, ankle, officially OUT, same report) against a Seattle offense the sim already has 3 points over the market total -- a verified signal the model cannot price since it would need to raise Seattle's own scoring, not lower Denver's (deliberately left out of injury_adjustments for that reason). CB Riley Moss (ribs) is questionable but trending to play. That argues for leaning the total over more than the model number alone, and keeps the spread read muddled since Denver's thin secondary is a real tailwind for Seattle's passing game that the market price may already be absorbing. Seattle's RB Zach Charbonnet (knee) is now confirmed OUT (seahawks.com Wed report), a minor committee-backfield loss already priced into the sim.
